comparison.objective: Spin wet lettuce in a hand-crank salad spinner at drying speed while keeping the loose lid and bowl stable.
comparison.physical_skill: Continuously crank a moving knob while the other hand restrains a reaction-loaded bowl and lid.
comparison.success_condition: Credit depends on basket speed above 300 rpm for specified durations and final crank release; excessive base motion, tilt, or lid displacement causes zero.
comparison.reason: Bimanual reaction restraint is generic overlap only; sustained cranking and lid stability do not test precision stop adjustment, jam-nut locking, or drift after cycles.
